title: Kill la Kill: Maximum Volume, Zero Restraint
author: Anastasiia Aleksieienko
content: Studio Trigger's breakout series turns school-uniform battles into a loud, self-aware celebration of over-the-top action.

title: Samurai Champloo and the Hip-Hop Edo Period
author: Oleksandr Morzynsky
content: Shinichiro Watanabe mixes a samurai road trip with lo-fi beats and scratching, and somehow the anachronism just works.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Guide to the Parts
author: Daria Talavira
content: Each part follows a new JoJo with a new setting and art style, so knowing where to start matters more than you might think.

title: SK8 the Infinity: Skateboarding as Pure Joy
author: Pavlo Kolinko
content: Bright colours, absurd downhill races and a sincere friendship at its core make SK8 one of Studio Bones' most fun originals.

title: Dan Da Dan: Aliens, Ghosts and Teenage Chaos
author: Yegor Reznichenko
content: Science Saru blends yokai horror, UFO conspiracies and a romcom into one of the most energetic adaptations in years.
